name: Vidhi Specialty Food Ingredients Limited

annual_report.business: Vidhi Specialty Food Ingredients Limited is a leading manufacturer of superior synthetic and natural food grade colours for applications in foods & beverages, confectionaries, pharmaceuticals, feeds, cosmetics, inkjet inks and salt free colours, distributed in over 80 countries across 6 continents.

capacity_or_capex.item: Capital expenditure - Property plant and equipments by geographical location (India)

key_risks: Inventory existence risk due to significance of inventory balance and complexity in determining quantities
Trade receivables risk due to significant portion of current assets and estimation of allowance for expected credit losses

latest_guidance.statement: Expect Dahej facility to run at optimal capacity before end of financial year
Dahej facility expected to run at optimal capacity before end of FY25

Confident of improving EBITDA performance quarter-on-quarter; expect double-digit growth from non-food business (currently 2.5-5% of revenue); non-food shift driven by fertilizer, ink, sanitation, personal care, healthcare industries
Expect full utilization of Dahej and Roha facilities in FY27
H2 FY27 expected to be similar or slightly better than H1 based on current order positions
